description: This file is a controller class for managing report extensions in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing available reports, installing, and uninstalling report extensions, handling permissions, and rendering the related views.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Controller class for managing report extensions within the OpenCart admin extension system, providing functionalities to list, install, and uninstall report extensions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point that outputs the list of report extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of available and installed report extensions, their statuses, and actions for the view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a report extension, including permission checks, registering controllers/models, and calling extension-specific install procedures.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process of a report extension, including permission checks and calling extension-specific uninstall procedures.
